steps.label: Tribunal Order Service
steps.caption: Party receives final appellate tribunal order initiating timeline.

steps.label: Substantial Law Filter
steps.caption: Court admits appeal strictly on substantial questions of law.

steps.label: Question Formulation
steps.caption: High court formulates specific question of law for formal hearing.

steps.label: Factual Immunity
steps.caption: Court declines to reweigh pure findings of fact absent perversity.

steps.label: Tax Effect Analysis
steps.caption: Revenue calculates disputed tax effect excluding interest and penalty.

steps.label: Monetary Filter
steps.caption: Appeal is barred if tax effect is below statutory board limits.

steps.label: Carve Out Verification
steps.caption: Authorities check for constitutional challenges or audit objections.

steps.label: Summary Dismissal
steps.caption: Court dismisses low tax effect appeals in limine preserving capital.

steps.label: Certificate of Fitness
steps.caption: High court considers whether case is fit for supreme court appeal.

steps.label: Special Leave Petition
steps.caption: Appellant petitions apex court within ninety days under constitution.

steps.label: Preliminary Hearing
steps.caption: Court evaluates whether special leave should be granted for hearing.

steps.label: Law of the Land
steps.caption: Final apex judgment merges lower order and binds all national courts.

steps.label: Jurisdictional Excess
steps.caption: Tax authority issues patently illegal order without statutory power.

steps.label: Natural Justice Breach
steps.caption: Officer fails to grant mandatory electronic personal video hearing.

steps.label: Writ of Certiorari
steps.caption: Taxpayer petitions high court to quash ultra vires assessment order.

steps.label: Immediate Injunction
steps.caption: High court stays recovery proceedings restoring corporate rights.

steps.label: High Court Deadline
steps.caption: Engine tracks one hundred twenty day limitation for statutory appeal.

steps.label: Monetary Limit Audit
steps.caption: System verifies whether departmental appeal complies with board policy.

steps.label: Writ Prerequisite Check
steps.caption: Module vets natural justice violations for constitutional filings.

steps.label: Precedent Alignment
steps.caption: Platform links corporate arguments with landmark apex court doctrines.
